g.text: Home Assistant can request an OTA maintenance window
by publishing "true" to the retained OTA request topic.
After startup and successful Wi-Fi / MQTT connection.
The regular measurement sequence documents these steps.
[Until maintenance window expires (unless the ESP32 restarts)]
If successful OTA handling restarts the ESP32,
this cycle ends before the final
Restart behavior depends on the OTA implementation.
Continue with the regular measurement cycle.
Skip OTA request processing for this cycle.
Read sensor and battery measurements, publish via MQTT,
